triples.tail_surface: Lightly lubricate impeller with grease compatible with pumped media and impeller elastomer
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用与泵送介质及叶轮弹性体兼容的润滑脂轻微润滑叶轮
triples.evidence_text: • Lightly lubricate impeller with grease compatible with pumped media and impeller elastomer.

triples.tail_surface: Push the impeller into the pump body with a twisting motion in the operating direction, centralizing the impeller hub to the shaft
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按运转方向以扭转动作将叶轮推入泵体并使叶轮轮毂对中于轴
triples.evidence_text: • Push the impeller into the pump body with a twisting motion in the operating direction, centralizing the impeller hub to the shaft.

triples.tail_surface: Ensure wearplate is clean and slide onto shaft until fully home against bearing housing/adaptor and ensure wearplate pin groove is locate on the body pin
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 确保耐磨板清洁并滑入轴上直至完全贴合轴承座/适配器，且耐磨板销槽对准泵体销
triples.evidence_text: • Ensure wearplate is clean and slide onto shaft until fully home against bearing housing/adaptor and ensure wearplate pin groove is locate on the body pin.

triples.tail_surface: Appropriate sealant should be applied to the body mating surface of the cam
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在凸轮与泵体配合面涂敷适当密封剂
triples.evidence_text: • Appropriate sealant should be applied to the body mating surface of the cam

triples.tail_surface: Ensure cam pin is present in body and fit cam to impeller bore
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 确认泵体内凸轮销就位并将凸轮装入叶轮孔
triples.evidence_text: • Ensure cam pin is present in body and fit cam to impeller bore.

triples.tail_surface: Fix cam screw through body and tighten
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 穿过泵体固定凸轮螺钉并拧紧
triples.evidence_text: • Fix cam screw through body and tighten.

triples.tail_surface: Slide seal onto shaft until seal faces meet
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将密封件滑入轴上直至密封面贴合
triples.evidence_text: • Slide seal onto shaft until seal faces meet.

triples.tail_surface: Refit seal retaining ring into groove
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将密封挡圈重新装入沟槽
triples.evidence_text: • Refit seal retaining ring into groove.

triples.tail_surface: Lightly grease o-ring/gasket and onto body
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 对O形圈/垫片及泵体 lightly 涂抹润滑脂
triples.evidence_text: • Lightly grease o-ring/gasket and onto body.

triples.tail_surface: Ensure end cover is clean and align bolt holes with body threads
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 确保端盖清洁并对齐螺栓孔与泵体螺纹
triples.evidence_text: • Ensure end cover is clean and align bolt holes with body threads.

triples.tail_surface: Fit all bolts with washers finger tight to hold end cover in place
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用带垫圈的螺栓手拧预紧以固定端盖
triples.evidence_text: • Fit all bolts with washers finger tight to hold end cover in place.

triples.tail_surface: Tighten all bolts to torque shown in table
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按表中所示扭矩拧紧所有螺栓
triples.evidence_text: • Tighten all bolts to torque shown in table.
